verdict_text:
YES

The script loads all three checkpoints, verifies the key sets are identical and that every non-MLP tensor is bit-equal across base/ft1/ft2 before any merging, then computes `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)` in float32 against the unmodified base for each of the 48 regex-matched MLP tensors, copies all other tensors from the base unchanged, asserts `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 160`, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`. The regex `fullmatch` restricts to exactly the four `h.<i>.mlp.*` names, and the cast back to `base[name].dtype` is a no-op for float32 inputs.
